reviewer: independent reviewer C (wave C shard c)
headline: Four families reviewed against their own current bytes and their official source bytes, zero approved. Three carry corrections; CC 6:12 additionally needs an ownership ruling. The Nebraska caption defect is one shared root cause: refusing to write a widget never clears its appearance, and the county fact is bound to a caption hint field rather than to the slot the form's own calculate action defines.

sourceVerification.method: SHA-256 recomputed by this reviewer from the official source bytes and compared against each family's own source-record.json, source-receipt.json, artifact-provenance.json and the digest embedded in the sidecar sourceUrl. The source pack's own manifest was not used as proof.
sourceVerification.result: all four agree; byte lengths match; visible form numbers and revisions read off page 1 of each blank source

verdicts.observed: The applicant has no street address anywhere on a sworn affidavit of indigency. Both primary street lines (source rects (37,117,315,133) and (37,133,315,149), directly beneath the printed caption 'Street Number And Street Name, Including Apartment Or Unit Number If Applicable') are refused no_allowlisted_fact_matches although participant.street_address is available and is bound in all three Nebraska families of this shard. Both mailing street lines ((38,181,315,194) and (37,193,315,206), beneath 'Full Permanent Mailing Address Of Applicant (if different than above)') are refused as protected_category 'money' while field-classification.json classifies them 'participant' — their effectiveLabel is undecoded Identity-H glyph ids that decode to 'Full Permanent Mailing Address'. Meanwhile 'Springfield', 'XX' and '01234' are each written twice, filling the conditional block with values identical to the block above it. Every address widget in the blank source is empty, so both copies are this build's.
verdicts.required: Street-address lines receive the street address; a street line is never routed into a protected financial category; the conditional mailing block stays unwritten when it equals the block above; each participant value appears once.
verdicts.smallestCorrection: Decode captured labels through the font ToUnicode CMap before classifying so an unreadable label cannot fall through to 'money'; accept the 'Street Number And Street Name' caption form in the street_address descriptor; gate the conditional mailing block on the two addresses actually differing.

verdicts.fieldOrGeometry: the venue caption band: TYPEOFCOURTDROPDOWN, DROPDOWNCOUNTY2, TYPEOFCOURTRESULTS, 'enter the county', fullcountystatementRIGHT
verdicts.observed: The refused ComboBoxes keep their unselected default option, whose display label is 'Choose the court' / 'Choose the county'. Those labels flatten onto the filed page at (144.3,120.2,198.6,131.0) inside TYPEOFCOURTDROPDOWN (142,119,221,133) and (291.8,120.2,351.3,131.0) inside DROPDOWNCOUNTY2 (290,119,369,133). 'Choose the court' overprints the caption hint field 'enter the type of court' (147.8,117.8,225.0,128.5) so neither string is legible. Separately, the source's own calculate actions define the caption's composition — TYPEOFCOURTRESULTS takes this.getField("TYPEOFCOURTDROPDOWN").value (a full phrase such as 'IN THE DISTRICT COURT OF') and fullcountystatementRIGHT takes this.getField("DROPDOWNCOUNTY2").value. The build wrote the bare name 'District Court' into TYPEOFCOURTRESULTS, wrote matter.county into 'enter the county' (a caption hint field whose source value is '(Enter the county name)') and left fullcountystatementRIGHT at its default '                            COUNTY, NEBRASKA '. The filed caption therefore reads 'District Court' 'Example County' 'COUNTY, NEBRASKA'.
verdicts.required: One value per caption slot, written into the slot the form's own calculate action defines; the court's printed caption words preserved; no source placeholder text on a filed pleading.
verdicts.smallestCorrection: Clear the appearance stream of every refused or unwritten widget before flatten; rebind matter.county from 'enter the county' to fullcountystatementRIGHT and clear the hint field; map matter.court to the ComboBox export value rather than a display name.

ownerDecision.question: Should the movant's own name be written into the caption of CC 6:12, as it is on both companion Nebraska forms in this shard?
ownerDecision.rectangle: source widget rect (108,247,305,261) — the 'vs. ____, (your full name) Defendant.' caption slot on page 1
ownerDecision.observed: classified 'manual' and refused 'classified_unwritable_by_role', so the filed Motion carries no movant name in its caption while the same participant's name is printed on page 2. NE:cc-6-11-form-en and NE:cc-6-11-2-form-en bind their equivalent caption field 'defendant' to participant.full_legal_name and write it. The source shows the field is an ordinary empty text widget in the caption, identical in kind to the companion forms'.
ownerDecision.whyThisIsNotAMechanicalCorrection: both readings are defensible — a caption name may be reserved for hand completion, or it may be participant-owned like every other instance of the same fact on the same document. The three Nebraska forms currently disagree with each other and nothing records which reading is intended. Choosing would decide document ownership, which is outside a reviewer's authority.
